interest: This cross-reference sheet is historically valuable for researchers tracing Japanese economic and financial penetration into French Indochina following the military occupation of the northern territory in the autumn of 1940. It highlights the role of the Yokohama Specie Bank as an instrument of Japanese imperial expansion, establishing banking infrastructure in Hanoi or Haiphong to support commerce and military operations. It also provides a direct archival link to the original reporting telegram in the French Indochina files (851g.51694/1).
overview: This file consists of a single State Department cross-reference sheet (894.51651G/1) dated November 19, 1940, directing researchers to telegram No. 40 (4 p.m.) from Saigon (Hanoi), which is filed under decimal file 851g.51694/1. The indexed document relates to the opening of a branch of the Yokohama Specie Bank at Haiphong or Hanoi, reflecting Japanese commercial and financial expansion into French Indochina during late 1940.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet referencing a telegram from Saigon (Hanoi) regarding the opening of a branch of the Yokohama Specie Bank in Haiphong or Hanoi.
subfiles.summary: This cross-reference file sheet records telegram No. 40, sent at 4 p.m. on November 19, 1940, from the American diplomatic post in Saigon (Hanoi). It references intelligence and information concerning the establishment of a branch of the Yokohama Specie Bank at Haiphong or Hanoi. The original paper is filed under State Department decimal file 851g.51694/1.
